scope: Add a public-page optional browser helper using the existing JavaScript API: source questions, native conversation and recoverable clarification, reviewed collection/source drafts and separately labeled general model chat.

Honor the zero-cost constraint with no paid AI service, shared inference backend, GPU training or API key. Core MPLPB and manual reviewed building work without a neural model. Optional pretrained Phi-4-mini is visitor-device inference, not inference on GitHub Pages.

Retain exact original source queries, selected collection/delivery profile, engine replies/citations, source integrity and authorship restrictions. Model proposals cannot execute writes before explicit draft approval or choose other tools/scopes.

Record inspectable input, semantic proposal, actual model transport when used, approval, actual calls, results and rendered text; never claim a neural internal reasoning transcript. Prepare attributed candidate owner prose separately, not an approved conversation dataset or automatic training.

Preserve all historical source/evaluation material. Add pinned optional runtime/licenses, public setup/limitations, authored real-engine/browser/asset/data tests, CI checks and latest-instruction repository handoff.
validation: Baseline main 9f03116d32bba20b69f0ec9cddf58eb799ab8f17 merged the local MCP interface. PR #31 regression and exact extracted-ZIP workflows each passed 865 Python tests and 45 official SDK checks; these are baseline results, not this implementation’s deployment evidence.

33 authored JavaScript contract checks passed against the actual Python engine, including model-plan rejection, exact supplied-text/query/citation preservation, delivery withholding, positive/negative conflict, reviewed/cancelled writes and saved procedure clarification/correction.

Eight authored Python asset/data tests passed. Current local Chromium evidence has nine checks on actual WebAssembly, reviewed imports and pending clarification recovery after a real page reload; live model generation is not included. Frozen candidate and final deployment checks will be recorded separately.

Actual software GPU probe exposed WebGPU but no shader-f16. No Phi-4 tensor download or neural generation was claimed. Public owner-material preparation captured 46 of 48 root READMEs, 1131 candidate passages, with exact-overlap screening against 1394 stored questions; raw review archive remains separate from the app.

Compared 900 protected files with baseline Git blobs, unchanged. See evaluation/free-browser-helper/preservation.json. No model training, independent human validation, unrestricted language understanding or iPad pass is claimed.

Frozen implementation 2e70d737c415b22a9f25d053f7e43ffffabc9fd8, tree 9c24f52a088134faf50be2e6f4efe691b4eb8cd4, exact ZIP SHA-256 d2b4005a18cc2618f2fdab0946643dacab376d87701c30db7453d3ad532b3324: extracted handoff/infrastructure/docs, eight focused tests, 33 actual native-engine checks and nine actual Chromium/WebAssembly workflow checks passed. See evaluation/free-browser-helper/extracted-zip.json. Full required CI and postdeployment remain separate.

The first full local run was blocked by restricted-sandbox loopback socket creation: 861 executed, nine errors and three dependent researcher-journey failures; LedgerUI setup prevented 12 tests from running. The log is preserved separately. Affected modules are being rerun with networking, and exact-head CI remains required. This blocked attempt is not represented as a pass.

The socket-enabled retry of four modules exposed one genuine single-inline-script packaging regression (65/66 passed) in preliminary implementation 2e70d73. Fixed helper embedding to initialize on DOMContentLoaded inside the existing script without changing any preexisting test or CSP rule. The same 66 tests now pass, along with eight focused Python tests, 33 native-engine checks and nine actual Chromium/WebAssembly checks. Both rerun logs and revised browser/code hashes are retained; final full CI remains separate.
limitations: The model loader is experimental until live inference is exercised on a compatible device. Approximately 2.16 GB tensors, roughly 3.44 GB upstream memory estimate plus overhead, WebGPU shader-f16 and adequate buffers are required. iPad/Safari are unverified. Core paths remain available if the model cannot run.

GitHub Pages serves a static public interface, not a shared AI/MCP backend. Each visitor’s browser storage is separate. No unlimited free bandwidth, storage or device compatibility is promised. Existing local stdio MCP remains a separate interface.

Model text/decisions are unverified; exact runtime transport is inspectable, hidden neural reasoning is not. Traces may contain source text and questions and are exported only on request. No visitor chat is used for training.

Prepared owner prose requires first-party and mixed-rights review before any future conversation dataset. Profile indexes were supplied but full papers/blogs were not bulk-captured. OpenAssistant is a recorded candidate, not downloaded or trained. Fine-tuning cannot be promised for zero cost.

No autonomous acquisition, ratification, source revision/deletion, cross-visitor ledger sharing or expansion of the existing deterministic source-language capabilities. Saving a draft does not establish truth or authenticated authorship.
next_steps: The preliminary frozen ZIP focused checks and revised-candidate local checks are complete; the preliminary revision is not a release. Inspect final exact-head regression/archive/browser/handoff/infrastructure CI before merge. Verify public Pages after deployment separately. Live Phi-4 inference remains unverified.

Use the existing public address and open Builder and chat helper. Source questions/native chat/manual reviewed imports need no model. Load optional Phi-4 only on a compatible device if the large download is acceptable; no paid fallback is configured.

For future updates, replace this instruction record from the latest task instructions, review affected documentation/result links, stage intended files and regenerate/check the repository-owned handoff. Do not import private chat or personal context into public training data.
